components.name: Static Site Build Pipeline
components.responsibility: Render templates and source data into the deployable site via scripts/build.py, failing closed when Python/Jinja dependencies are unavailable.

components.name: Public Link Integrity Checker
components.responsibility: Validate that public links and assets resolve via scripts/check-public-links.py before/after build.

components.name: Cloudflare Worker Edge Router
components.responsibility: Serve as the deployed worker entrypoint (worker/index.js) routing inbound requests and delegating agent traffic to the MCP server module.

components.name: MCP Server Module
components.responsibility: Implement the Model Context Protocol surface (worker/mcp/server.js) that exposes agent-facing tools/resources.

components.name: Public Agent Data & Discovery Metadata
components.responsibility: Provide machine-readable profile and agent discovery metadata as committed source (api/v1/profile.json, llms.txt).

components.name: Persona Representation Corpus
components.responsibility: Author the source-of-truth narrative for how AI agents represent Leon Breukelman across positioning, voice, strengths, stories, data sources, and contact (prompt/represent_me.md).

components.name: Project Documentation
components.responsibility: Onboard humans and AI agents with install, development, build, preview, deployment, and structure guidance (README.md).

contracts.name: Worker edge router invokes MCP server module

cross_cutting_concerns.description: Every component, contract, and check must trace to selected nodes and prov identifiers in the packet; no files, edges, or behaviors are invented beyond the supplied graph.
The build must be reproducible; scripts/build.py imports datetime, which can inject nondeterministic timestamps into rendered output and must be pinned or excluded from acceptance comparisons.
cross_cutting_concerns.triggered_by: scripts/build.py imports datetime via edge:9b853eb4121c2243cd48, risking nondeterministic build output

cross_cutting_concerns.description: Each emitted component and contract carries prov references back to its source node(s) so the decomposition is auditable against the repository.
The acceptance command must not invoke any live paid API; npm run build performs local rendering and npm run check:links performs unauthenticated public HTTP fetches only.
Generated surfaces are detected from git/filesystem truth and excluded from source component ownership.

goal: decompose the AI-first public site and agent metadata project into source-backed components across build scripts, JavaScript worker code, public JSON data, templates, and docs

planted_negatives.bad_decomposition_pattern: Merge worker/index.js and worker/mcp/server.js under a single 'Cloudflare Worker Code' component owning all of node:32f3a0d3845cf98fb8cb, node:javascript_import:worker.mcp.server, and node:1e8ba7fd1db36d8f49db, then drop contract:router-to-mcp because from_component_id and to_component_id would resolve to the same merged component.
planted_negatives.expected_gate_failure: Contract graph integrity check: contract:router-to-mcp declares from_component_id=comp:worker-edge-router and to_component_id=comp:mcp-server. If both are merged into one component, either both IDs point to a non-existent component (the merged one has a new ID) or the contract becomes a self-referential edge with from==to. Any gate validating that from_component_id != to_component_id and that both referenced IDs exist in the components list rejects this decomposition deterministically.
planted_negatives.why_hidden_from_primary: The primary decomposer (claude-opus-4-8) was given distinct source nodes for worker/index.js and worker/mcp/server.js and correctly split them on semantic responsibility. A file-bucket report generator grouping by filesystem directory (worker/) rather than by semantic boundary would bundle them. The probe tests whether the directed-contract endpoint distinctness invariant is enforced, not just whether files are listed.

planted_negatives.bad_decomposition_pattern: Move all ten persona corpus node IDs (node:270b52766ba2097c3bf8, node:087085bf23e3cc4628f2, node:3497d88db26b2742c66a, node:5ea405faea230cdf5498, node:7ad8da6a627ab8d27e9e, node:9d9d37a18c7ab7537c0f, node:c627dcac9798554af877, node:ca0aad13b3b497dd9e40, node:cd8a921454b74ef09e06, node:f0fd663527865f98c64e) into comp:public-agent-data's owned_node_ids on the grounds that represent_me.md is 'agent-facing content analogous to llms.txt', eliminate comp:persona-corpus as a distinct component, and repoint contract:build-renders-persona to to_component_id=comp:public-agent-data.
planted_negatives.expected_gate_failure: Near-neighbor alternative nn:persona-in-data is explicitly marked why_not_primary='prompt/represent_me.md is a distinct prose corpus with separate prov; it is authored representation guidance, not machine-readable API data.' A gate that checks whether any near_neighbor_alternative's rejected pattern is instantiated in the decomposition detects this. Additionally, a prov-node-to-component uniqueness check fails: persona prov refs (prov:756f566ef137b772 and siblings) conflict with comp:public-agent-data's prov refs (prov:5dd0cc494cd85fbe, prov:77b106b079f49cac), producing a multi-component prov collision.
planted_negatives.why_hidden_from_primary: The primary correctly distinguished machine-readable data (JSON, llms.txt) from prose corpus (Markdown sections with narrative structure). A generator classifying by consumer role ('both are agent-facing') rather than artifact type and authoring surface would merge them. The probe tests the near-neighbor exclusion gate and prov-uniqueness check.

planted_negatives.bad_decomposition_pattern: Add invented dist/ directory graph nodes to comp:build-pipeline's owned_node_ids with the rationale that 'the pipeline produces and therefore owns its output,' citing no prov refs for the added nodes.
planted_negatives.expected_gate_failure: Two gates fire. First, the non-goal enforcement gate checks that no owned_node_id resolves to a generated output surface; the project packet records surface_counts.generated=0, so any node corresponding to a dist/ artifact has no matching packet entry and fails this check. Second, the anti-fabrication concern (concern:anti-fabrication, triggered_by='universal') requires that every component's owned_node_ids trace to packet-supplied prov identifiers; dist/ nodes carry no prov ref and the anti-fabrication gate emits a fabricated-node violation.
planted_negatives.why_hidden_from_primary: The primary correctly scoped ownership to scripts/build.py and its packet-anchored prov. A naive generator conflating 'build pipeline' with 'everything the build touches or emits' would claim dist/ nodes. The probe tests both non-goal enforcement and anti-fabrication prov anchoring simultaneously.

planted_negatives.bad_decomposition_pattern: Remove concern:anti-fabrication from cross_cutting_concerns entirely, or reduce its component_ids to only ['comp:build-pipeline'] with triggered_by='conditional' on the rationale that 'fabrication risk is highest where data edges are missing (build pipeline only).'
planted_negatives.expected_gate_failure: Universal-concern coverage assertion: enumerate all seven component IDs from the components list; collect all cross_cutting_concerns with triggered_by='universal' and union their component_ids. With concern:anti-fabrication absent or scoped, only concern:provenance (if left universal) covers some components. Five component IDs—comp:link-checker, comp:worker-edge-router, comp:mcp-server, comp:persona-corpus, comp:project-docs—have no universal-concern coverage. The gate diffs the full component ID set against universally-covered IDs and emits a non-empty gap set, causing deterministic failure without any network call or model invocation.
planted_negatives.why_hidden_from_primary: The primary modeled anti-fabrication correctly as universal. A file-bucket report generator would not model cross-cutting concerns at all, or would scope them narrowly to where graph edges explicitly surface the risk. The probe tests universal-coverage enforcement across all seven components.

probe_builder_output.coverage_rationale: Probes cover: contract-graph structural integrity (probe 1), near-neighbor exclusion and prov-uniqueness (probe 2), non-goal and anti-fabrication enforcement (probe 3), and universal-concern coverage completeness (probe 4). Together they span the four primary failure modes a file-bucket report generator would exhibit relative to a semantic-responsibility decomposition.
probe_builder_output.discrimination_rate: 4/4 probes set discrimination_passed=true, conditioned on deterministic gate or probe rubric rejection of the planted bad decomposition pattern
probe_builder_output.independence_statement: Builder model claude-sonnet-4-6 did not participate in the primary decomposition by claude-opus-4-8. Probes were constructed solely from the project packet summary and primary decomposition provided in this prompt, without access to the primary decomposer's internal reasoning, chain-of-thought, or intermediate outputs.
probe_builder_output.rationale: Four probes were designed to discriminate semantic-responsibility decomposition from a fluent file-bucket report. Probe 1 (worker-mcp-distinct-endpoints) tests the contract directed-edge invariant that from_component_id != to_component_id; a directory-grouping generator merging worker/ files breaks this invariant deterministically. Probe 2 (persona-corpus-distinct-from-machine-data) tests near-neighbor exclusion gate enforcement for nn:persona-in-data and prov-uniqueness; a consumer-role classifier merging prose and JSON triggers both checks. Probe 3 (build-pipeline-source-only-no-dist) tests non-goal enforcement and anti-fabrication prov anchoring together; a pipeline-owns-output generator claims dist/ nodes that have no packet prov, failing both gates. Probe 4 (anti-fabrication-concern-is-universal) tests universal-concern coverage across all seven components; a generator skipping cross-cutting-concern modeling or scoping concerns conditionally leaves most components uncovered and trips the set-difference gate. All probes use only IDs present in the supplied decomposition packet; no graph node IDs were invented.
